title: Opside Light
description: New project of optimization for minecraft 1.20.1
body:
This **mod-pack** is focused on optimizing Minecraft **1.20.1 Forge**. This is the version of Minecraft with a high acceptance by the modding community, therefore it is important to have several of these optimization mods that relieve the CPU, GPU and especially the **Ram Memory**. This **mod-pack** has a **high compatibility** rate with third-party mods so you can attach the mods you like and there should be no problem. It also relieves the internal Local server, the mods will be constantly updated in stable versions.

Ultra-Minimum Ram:1 or 2 GB dedicated 
Minimum Ram:3GB dedicated 
**Vanilla game only**
